question: To what two qualifications of a recipient must a teaching be given, according to this restriction?
premises: A teaching is to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: Only one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind is a fit recipient.
uncertainties: Which teaching is meant is not named here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
